The face having '44' is adjacent to the faces having 22, 66, 33 and 11.

Thus, the face having '44' is opposite to the face having '55'.

'BK + EZ' is coded as '737'.

B = 2 and K = 11. So, BK is written as 211. E = 5 and Z = 26. So, EZ is written as 526.

211+526= 737.

'IC + PD' is coded as '257'.

I = 9 and C= 3. So, IC is written as 93. P = 16 and D = 4. So, PD is written as 164.

93+164= 257.

Similarly,

L = 12 and G = 7. So, LG is written as 127. M = 13 and F = 6. So, MF is written as 136.

127+136= 263.

questions.q_en: All 90 students of a class are standing in a row facing south. Mohan is 45th from the right end while Shivam is 33rd from the left end. How many people are standing between Mohan and Shivam?

Total number of students standing = 90

Position of Mohan + Position of Shivam = 45+33=78

Number of people standing between Mohan and Shivam = 90-78=12

So, twelve people are standing between Mohan and Shivam.
